text: I think the view from our clients overseas is I think trust is more important than your specific technology.
where: Web Summit Lisbon 2026, Commerce Summit panel

text: It doesn't matter how advanced you are, it's how fast you respond.
where: Web Summit Lisbon 2026, Commerce Summit panel

text: The most simple thing you can do is get someone to trust you personally, not end to end AI trust, but human trust. They like you, right? If someone likes you, they'll figure out a way to work with you. If they don't like you, they'll make sure you'll never be successful.
where: Web Summit Lisbon 2026, Commerce Summit panel

text: What China's teaching us is not that we need to copy China's government or their systems, but that competition, which China learned from the West, by the way, works.
where: Web Summit Lisbon 2026, Commerce Summit panel

text: China's not rising, China is resuming. … So it's not the case that we have to just follow China. We can work with China and become stronger together.
where: Web Summit Lisbon 2026, Commerce Summit panel

text: Technology can all be copied. The only thing that can't be copied is relationships and trust.
original: 技术都可以复制，唯一无法复制的是关系和信任。
where: the China-EU Forum at Web Summit 2026 in Lisbon

text: Don't fight over a single grain of rice. Make the pie bigger.
original: 不要为一小粒米争抢，要把饼做大。
where: the China-EU Forum at Web Summit 2026 in Lisbon

text: The best business strategy today is to shake hands, have coffee and make friends in person. ... The most effective way to grow a business is actually the oldest one: making friends face to face.
original: 现在最好的一个做业务的战略，就是在线下握手、喝咖啡、交朋友。……最有效果的业务拓展方式，其实是最古老的一个方式，就是线下交朋友。
where: an online keynote for business leaders

text: To do business globally you need three things, an iron triangle: a good product is the foundation; a fair price is what persuades; and the third is trust.
original: 做全球生意你要三个事情，一个铁三角的概念：你产品好，肯定是一个基础；你价格合适，这个是有说服力的；第三个……一个课题是信任关系。
where: an online keynote for business leaders

text: If you have trust locally, people accept you and like you, and they will find ways to support and help you instead of finding ways to stop you.
original: 如果你有信任关系在本地的话，人家接受你、喜欢你，他们会想方设法支持你、帮助你，而不是想方设法阻止你。
where: an online keynote for business leaders

text: When someone introduces you to a client or an opportunity, it is not because your product is good, but because they believe you are reliable.
original: 人家给你介绍一个客户、给你介绍机会，不是因为你的产品好，而是因为他认为你靠谱。
where: an online keynote for business leaders

text: Over the next ten years, how far Chinese companies grow will depend on who has built trust, and who has not and ends up being driven out.
original: 未来十年，中国企业进一步的发展会取决于谁建立了信任，然后谁没有信任，然后被驱逐、被赶走。
where: an online keynote for business leaders

text: We would never want to use AI to reach another AI. We want to reach people and have them like us. So the work AI will not replace in the foreseeable future is the work that involves people.
original: 我们绝对不会想用 AI 去联系另一个 AI。我们是想联系到人，让人喜欢我们。所以 AI 在可见的未来不会替代的工作，是跟人相关的。
where: an online keynote for business leaders

text: Having a good product at a good price is not enough. Overseas, you still have to make friends.
original: 你的产品好、价格好是不够的，你在海外还是要交朋友。
where: the New Globalization Summit 2026, panel session in Suzhou

text: Don't position yourself as a foreigner. You are a French company that comes from China.
original: 不要把自己定位为外国人，你就是来自中国的法国公司。
where: the New Globalization Summit 2026, panel session in Suzhou

text: Smart brands don't compete on product and price. They compete on relationships and trust.
original: 聪明的品牌方不是卷产品和价格，而是卷关系、卷信任。
where: the New Globalization Summit 2026, panel session in Suzhou

text: Culture is a tool for lowering the cost of communication.
original: 文化是一个降低沟通成本的工具。
where: the New Globalization Summit 2026, panel session in Suzhou

text: "Go global or get out" is a fallacy.
original: 不出海就出局，是一个谬论。
where: the New Globalization Summit 2026, panel session in Suzhou

text: We are moving from taking products abroad, and then brands abroad, into an era of deeper globalization and localization. Don't position yourself as a foreigner who has "gone overseas". Be a local company that happens to come from China.
original: 从产品出海、品牌出海,我们正在迈进深化的全球化与本土化时代——不要把自己定位成‘出海的外国人’,而要做来自中国的本地企业。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: An American company would never say "we are a US company that has gone overseas to Canada". They are a Canadian company that comes from America.
original: 美国企业绝对不会说『我们是美国出海企业到加拿大』——他们是来自美国的加拿大企业。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: Responsibility at the front, power at headquarters: it's easy to set up and easy to get wrong. Don't separate power from responsibility. Whoever makes the decision should bear the responsibility.
original: 责任在前方、权力在总部——很容易做,也很容易走错;不要把权力和责任分开:谁做决定,谁就应该承担责任。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: This new trend of Chinese globalization is not de-globalization. It is a new generation of globalization, driven by China.
original: 中国的全球化这个新趋势,不是逆全球化,而是中国推动的新一代的全球化。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: The way I see it, culture is a tool for lowering the cost of communication.
original: 在我的认知里面,我把文化看作是一个降低沟通成本的工具。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: When you advertise yourself, you are less credible. When others say good things about you, you are more credible. The more I tell you I'm excellent, the less excellent you think I am.
original: 你自己做广告的可信度会低;别人说你的好话,可信度更高。——我越说我优秀,你越觉得我不优秀。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: In the age of AI, third-party voices matter more than ever.
original: 在 AI 时代,第三方的声音特别重要。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: At home, Chinese companies understand very well how important relationships and friends are. Once they go overseas, they overlook the people and look only at the project timeline.
original: 国内非常懂关系和朋友的重要性,但到海外以后会忽略所有的人,只看项目推进时间。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: Language translation can be replaced; what we need more is cross-cultural translators.
original: 语言翻译可以被替代；我们更需要的是跨文化翻译官。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: What matters most today is not buying traffic ads and selling. It is, at the company level and the relationship level, getting overseas markets to accept us and like us.
original: 今天最重要的不是做投流广告销售，而是从企业层面和关系层面，让海外接受我们、喜欢我们。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: The next ten years belong to China and Chinese companies, and the direction is very promising. The pitfalls to watch out for are often other Chinese peers, not just the Western rivals who are receding.
original: 未来十年，属于中国和中国企业——方向非常有希望；要小心走的坑，往往是其他中国同行，而不只是正在退潮的美欧对手。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: In my understanding, culture is a tool for lowering the cost of communication.
original: 文化，在我的认知里，是一个降低沟通成本的工具。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: After a meeting, your customer will definitely look you up on Google, ChatGPT or DeepSeek. What affects conversion most is whether you and your company can withstand a background check.
original: 客户开完会一定会去 Google / ChatGPT / DeepSeek 查你；转化率影响最大的，是你和公司经不经得起背调。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: If headquarters has power without responsibility, spending decisions get careless. Tell them "you make the decision, you take the blame," and they become far more careful.
original: 总部只有权力没有责任，花钱做决定会随意一点；告诉他『你做决定你要背锅』，他们会慎重很多。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: When hiring foreigners to work with Chinese teams, language is not the most important thing. High emotional intelligence and the ability to accept uncertainty: with those two, they can keep up with a Chinese team.
original: 招外籍对中国团队，语言不是最重要；高情商、能不能接受不确定性——这两个点有了，才跟得上中国团队。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: Going global, put plainly, is not about making money. It is about whether we will have a peaceful world in the future.
original: 出海说白了不是赚钱的事情，是未来我们是不是有一个和平的世界。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: Building trust is universal. How we build it is the difference we need to learn today.
original: 我们建立信任这个事情是全球通用;我们怎么样建立信任,才是今天要学习的区别。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: Advertising can solve awareness, but it cannot solve credibility.
original: 广告可以解决知名度,但解决不了可信度。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: Trust is built through other people. We can't rely on ourselves alone; we need third-party endorsement in the market, people who speak well of us.
original: 信任是通过别人去建立的——我们不能只靠自己;我们需要第三方市场背书,说我们的好话。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: If you say overseas, "I am a Chinese company going global," you have already positioned yourself as a foreigner.
original: 如果你在海外说『我是一个中国出海企业』,你已经把自己定位为外国人。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: You may get in because of your connections. You stay because of the trust you have built locally.
original: 你能准入,可能是你的关系;你能留下来,是你的信任在本地。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: We are witnessing the next phase of globalization, not deglobalization. It is the ebbing of the West's over-globalization, and what follows is a more complex but also more genuinely global footprint.
original: 我们正在见证全球化的下一个阶段,并不是逆全球化;那是西方过度全球化的退潮,带来的是更复杂、但也更真正的全球化布局。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: I don't believe any one person can solve all your problems, because that person has enemies too.
original: 我不相信一个人能帮你解决所有问题——因为那个人也有敌人。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: We would rather keep the cost of communication inside the company than pass it on to the customer.
original: 我们宁愿把沟通成本留在内部,不要把沟通成本丢给客户。
where: a training in Singapore for Chinese executives

text: The technology gap is narrowing, while the trust gap is widening.
original: 技术差距在缩小,信任差距在扩大。
where: the Hebei Distinctive Industries Belt and Road International Trade Cooperation Conference

text: Trust is now the number one factor in global brand competition.
original: 信任,已是品牌全球竞争的第一要素。
where: the Hebei Distinctive Industries Belt and Road International Trade Cooperation Conference

text: I see that the latest data shows that in 2025, more Chinese companies going global headed to Europe than to North America.
original: 我看到，最新数据显示，2025年中国出海企业前往欧洲的数量已经超过了北美。
where: the Yicai Global 10th Anniversary Ecosystem Conference and New Decade Strategy Launch

text: When Chinese companies go out into the world one by one, what stands behind them is further globalization.
original: 一个个出海企业走向世界的时候，背后是进一步的全球化。
where: the Yicai Global 10th Anniversary Ecosystem Conference and New Decade Strategy Launch
